labs.research_summary: Tong (Tony) Gao conducts research across fluid mechanics, soft matter, and materials using mathematical modeling and simulation. His work explores fluid-structure interactions to reveal fundamental mechanisms in complex fluid-solid systems and drive innovations in energy conversion, robotics, and biomedical applications. He specializes in developing and integrating high-performance computational tools for large-scale simulations, enabling multiscale modeling and analysis.

labs.research_summary:
Hungtang Ko's research focuses on the collective organization of biological collectives and robot swarms in fluid environments. He conducts animal experiments, simulates agent-based models, and designs biomimetic robots to investigate the physical interaction among insect swarms and fish schools. Beyond his core research, his diverse research interests extend to traffic flow, animal biomechanics, and the physics of wok tossing.

**Recruiting new PhD students for admission in Fall 2026**
